Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • OSHA Aerial - Scissor and Boom Lift Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.67, 29 CFR 1926.451, and 29 CFR 1926.453.
  • OSHA Driving Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1926.601 and OSHA’s General Duty Clause.
  • OSHA Forklift Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.178 and 29 CFR 1926.602(d).
  • Pallet Jack (Manual, Electric) Online Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Standards 29 CFR 1910.178 and 29 CFR 1926.602.
  • OSHA Powered Mobile Equipment Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.178, 29 CFR 1926.602, 29 CFR 1910.67, 29 CFR 1926.451, and 29 CFR 1926.453.
How long does Forklift, Aerial Lift & Powered Equipment Safety Training take?
  • Motor Vehicles and Mechanized Equipment Training for Construction: 1 hour.
  • OSHA Motorized Mobile Platforms Safety Awareness Training: 1 hour.
  • OSHA Aerial - Scissor and Boom Lift Safety Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Driving Safety Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Forklift Safety Training: 4 hours.
  • Pallet Jack (Manual, Electric) Online Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Powered Mobile Equipment Safety Training: 6 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Do I get a certificate?

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

  • Motor Vehicles and Mechanized Equipment Training for Construction: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Motorized Mobile Platforms Safety Awareness Training: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Aerial - Scissor and Boom Lift Safety Training: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Driving Safety Training: valid 12 months
  • OSHA Forklift Safety Training: valid 36 months

  • OSHA Powered Mobile Equipment Safety Training: valid 36 months
Can I take the training on my phone?

Yes. The training is 100% online and works on phones, tablets and computers, 24 hours a day.

Can I buy training for my whole team?

Yes. Enter the number of seats at checkout. Team pricing starts at 2 seats and goes up to 10% off for 501–1,000 seats. For larger orders or invoicing, call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

Is the training available in Spanish?

These courses are available in English and Spanish:

  • OSHA Aerial - Scissor and Boom Lift Safety Training
  • OSHA Driving Safety Training

  • Pallet Jack (Manual, Electric) Online Training

The others are in English.

How do I start my course after I pay?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your receipt and your login for the learning portal. Sign in at hazwoper-osha.com to begin.

Who provides the training?

Courses are delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. Questions? Call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

See the refund policy on hazwoper-osha.com, or call us before you start a course.
